title: Topic and time-series analysis describes patterns in archived police radio communications
summary: The study reports seasonal activity, keyword and technology-adoption patterns in its radio corpus, with transcription checks and topic-model analyses. The descriptive corpus analysis does not establish individual-level behavior, causal policy effects or representativeness beyond the sampled radio streams.
ai_technology: Speech transcription, topic modeling and temporal and regional analyses were applied to archived police-radio communications.
